marta: heads up — saw a cascade of spot evictions in ap-southeast during the 02:00 UTC batch window. a bunch of batch pods restarted and we dropped ~20% throughput. dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood/cluster/evictions :slightly_frowning_face:
liam: ugh. any logs or node ids?
marta: pasted a short snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:15Z] evict: host=gce-34 zone=ap-southeast1-b reason=PREEMPT pool=spot-low-cost bucket=alpha
[2026-03-17T02:12:16Z] kube: pod my-batch-1234 evicted, restartCount=1
```
ops-bot: Notice: autoscaler reduced spot-low-cost by 12 nodes (preemption surge)
jay: this matches the pattern we've seen — long-running batch on low-cost spots. proposal: introduce "eviction-coordinator" that implements graceful drain+checkpoint+steering to mixed pools
sophia: agree. concrete bucket plan: low-cost (volatile spot), mixed (spot+reserved mix), reserved (all reserved). routing: batch -> low-cost; interactive -> mixed; critical -> reserved. add handoff limits so we don't thrash
liam: fine, but migrating running pods is tricky. how do we avoid duplicate work or lost progress?
marta: idea: coordinator watches cloud preemption signal, then marks node draining and notifies scheduler with a drain-window (e.g., 90s). scheduler will try checkpoint/commit work. if checkpoint succeeds, reschedule continuation onto mixed spot; if not, fall back to reserved
jay: sketch of the hook:
```
on_preempt(node):
  set_node_taint(draining=true)
  notify_scheduler(window=90s)
  attempt_checkpoint(pod)
  if checkpoint_success:
    reschedule(pod, target_bucket=mixed)
  else:
    reschedule(pod, target_bucket=reserved)
```
sophia: also want off-peak shift: between 00:00-06:00 UTC increase batch concurrency and accept longer drain windows so we can favor cheaper spot usage overnight
liam: cost concern: shifting too many to reserved will spike hourly spend. we need heuristics: only promote to reserved when expected_remaining_runtime > X and preempt_prob > Y
marta: one heuristic: expected_preempt_rate = 1 - exp(-job_remaining / median_spot_lifetime). rely on lifetime histograms from k8s-metrics to estimate median_spot_lifetime
jay: let's run a staging experiment: create bucket 'experiment-mixed-2' with 60% spot, add eviction-coordinator, run synthetic batch for 48h, measure fallback rate and cost delta
sophia: i'll own the experiment setup and the runbook. will also add alerts: pager if fallback_rate > 5% over 1h or if average checkpoint_time > 60s
liam: i'll update the cost model and produce projected delta for month-over-month spend under two scenarios (no-coordinator vs coordinator)
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy-bot scheduled rollout: eviction-coordinator v0.1 -> staging at 2026-03-20T03:00Z
marta: awesome. follow-ups: @sophia experiment + runbook, @liam cost projections, @jay scheduler hook PR. i'll open a tracking ticket and tag this thread. ping me when PR is ready :thumbsup:
